description: Assistant order tools (place + real look-up) and handler wiring, with strands-free/boto3-free unit tests. In app/assistant/tools.py add the server-side pricing + status-derivation primitives and the two factory @tools; in app/assistant/handler.py bind them to the real OrdersTable and surface placed orders in the HTTP envelope from the request side channel. This is the container-image (assistant) half of the task and must leave the Python suite green. Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level, but it defines the item shape, the /api/chat placedOrder envelope, and the derive_status thresholds that FEAT-002 (orders_list) and FEAT-003 (SPA) consume — so it is implemented FIRST. See design.md sections 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 12.
steps: In app/assistant/tools.py add `import re` and (locally, inside the put_item path only) a runtime reference to botocore.exceptions.ClientError that is caught defensively WITHOUT a top-level botocore import (so the module stays importable under test). Keep the existing guarded `from strands import tool` identity-decorator fallback and the `from . import pii` import.
Add MENU_PRICES = {'flat white':4.50,'latte':4.75,'croissant':3.00,'coco cake':5.25} with the design.md section 3 comment (server-side source of truth; the model never supplies a price).

Add _TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*(?:(\d+)\s*[xX]\s*)?(.+?)\s*$') and a pure price_order(summary) -> (total: float, normalized_summary: str) | dict. Implement the LOCKED grammar/normalization/rejection from design.md section 3: split on commas; parse optional leading '<int> x'/'<int>x'; normalize item via re.sub(r'\s+',' ', raw.strip()).lower(); look up MENU_PRICES; reject (dict, write nothing) on empty summary / no recognizable items ({'status':'REJECTED','reason':'no recognizable menu items'}), unknown item ({'status':'REJECTED','reason':'unknown menu item: <name>'}), qty non-numeric or <=0 or >20 ({'status':'REJECTED','reason':'invalid quantity'}), total<=0 ({'status':'REJECTED','reason':'empty order'}). Plurals are NOT accepted (exact names only). Rebuild normalized_summary as ', '.join(f'{qty}x {Title Cased canonical}') and round total to 2 decimals.

Add PREPARING_AFTER=20 and READY_AFTER=60 constants and a pure derive_status(created_at:int, now:int)->str implementing the half-open intervals from design.md section 4: elapsed<20 RECEIVED, elapsed<60 PREPARING, else READY (elapsed==60 -> READY). Carry the exact comment from the design; this copy is the canonical one that orders_list mirrors in FEAT-002.

Add factory make_place_order(orders_table, req_ctx) returning @tool place_order(items: str) -> dict, mirroring make_initiate_refund. Behavior (design.md section 6.1): price_order(items); on REJECTED return the dict and write/append nothing. Else generate order_id=f'ORD-{random.randint(0,999999):06d}', assert pii.validate_order_id(order_id); summary=pii.mask_pii(normalized_summary); created_at=int(time.time()); item={'orderId':order_id,'summary':summary,'total':Decimal(str(total)),'status':'RECEIVED','createdAt':created_at,'gsiPk':'ORDER'}; orders_table.put_item(Item=item, ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(orderId)'); on ClientError with Error.Code=='ConditionalCheckFailedException' regenerate the id ONCE and retry the conditional put, and if it collides again return {'status':'REJECTED','reason':'could not allocate order id'} (append nothing); on success req_ctx.setdefault('placed_orders',[]).append({'orderId':order_id,'summary':summary,'total':total,'status':'RECEIVED'}) and return {'status':'RECEIVED','orderId':order_id,'summary':summary,'total':total}. Import random/time/Decimal (from decimal import Decimal) at module top (all stdlib, strands/boto3-free).

Add factory make_look_up_order(orders_table) returning @tool look_up_order(order_id: str) -> dict doing a real GetItem (design.md section 6.2): if not pii.validate_order_id(order_id) -> {'status':'REJECTED','reason':'invalid order id format'}; got=orders_table.get_item(Key={'orderId':order_id}); item=got.get('Item'); if not item -> {'status':'NOT_FOUND','orderId':order_id}; else the LOCKED OK shape {'status':'OK','orderId':order_id,'summary':item['summary'],'total':float(item['total']),'orderStatus':derive_status(int(item['createdAt']),int(time.time())),'createdAt':int(item['createdAt'])}. Do NOT collapse status and orderStatus.
REMOVE the current bare `@tool def look_up_order(...)` stub from tools.py entirely (it is replaced by make_look_up_order).

In app/assistant/handler.py replace the import line with EXACTLY `from .tools import make_initiate_refund, make_look_up_order, make_place_order` and ensure no other bare `look_up_order` reference remains anywhere in the file.

In _build_agent(req_ctx) build both tables when boto3 is present: orders_table = ddb.Table(os.environ['ORDERS_TABLE']); pending_table = ddb.Table(os.environ['PENDING_REFUNDS_TABLE']). Bind initiate_refund = make_initiate_refund(pending_table, req_ctx, max_refund=_max_refund()); look_up_order = make_look_up_order(orders_table); place_order = make_place_order(orders_table, req_ctx); return Agent(model=model, tools=[look_up_order, place_order, initiate_refund]).

In build_response(reply_text, req_ctx) add, after the pendingRefund block, a placedOrder branch (design.md section 8): placed = req_ctx.get('placed_orders') or []; if placed: latest = placed[-1]; body['placedOrder'] = {'orderId':latest['orderId'],'summary':latest['summary'],'total':latest['total'],'status':latest['status']}. Built from the side channel only, never from reply_text.

In app/tests/test_tools.py REWRITE test_look_up_order_validates to build via tools.make_look_up_order(_StubTable(...)) per design.md section 12 (bad id rejects WITHOUT a table call; found case returns status=='OK' with orderStatus in {RECEIVED,PREPARING,READY}). Add a _StubTable with get_item(Key) and put_item(Item=..., ConditionExpression=...) that can optionally raise a fake ClientError-shaped error on first call.

In app/tests/test_tools.py add tests for price_order (valid multi-item total + normalized summary; unknown item -> REJECTED; bad/zero/>20 qty -> REJECTED; empty -> REJECTED; case-insensitivity + whitespace collapse), derive_status boundaries (19 RECEIVED, 20 PREPARING, 59 PREPARING, 60 READY), and make_place_order (writes item with gsiPk=='ORDER', status=='RECEIVED', total is a Decimal; appends authoritative record to req_ctx['placed_orders']; REJECTED input writes/appends nothing; conditional-put collision stub triggers exactly one retry then clean REJECT).

Add build_response placedOrder tests (new file app/tests/test_handler.py or extend an existing one): a req_ctx with placed_orders yields a placedOrder block; both pending_refunds and placed_orders present yields both blocks; pass reply_text containing a DIFFERENT fake order id and assert the envelope uses the side-channel id. Add a handler-import-safety test asserting `import assistant.handler` succeeds with strands/boto3 absent and that _build_agent is NOT executed at import (e.g. the module imports and build_response works on a plain dict).
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m pytest app/tests -q is all green (existing tests adapted, new tests pass).

`python3 -c "import assistant.handler"` succeeds with neither strands nor boto3 installed (guarded imports), proving no stale bare look_up_order reference and that _build_agent is not run at import time.
tools.MENU_PRICES, tools.price_order, tools.derive_status, tools.make_place_order, tools.make_look_up_order all exist; the bare tools.look_up_order symbol no longer exists.

place_order fails closed (REJECTED, no write, no side-channel append) for unknown item, bad quantity, and empty order; a valid order writes an item with gsiPk=='ORDER', status=='RECEIVED', Decimal total, and appends {orderId,summary,total,status} to req_ctx['placed_orders'].
look_up_order returns the single locked contract (top-level status in {OK,NOT_FOUND,REJECTED}; orderStatus derived) and never collapses the two.

HARD INVARIANTS preserved: side-channel-only id in build_response; pii.mask_pii applied to summary before put_item; total computed server-side from MENU_PRICES; no model-id change; assistant IAM/env untouched (code-only change).
verification: From the demo root: python3 -m py_compile $(find app -name '*.py')
From the demo root: python3 -m pytest app/tests -q  (expect all green)

From the demo root: python3 -c "import assistant.handler; from assistant import tools; assert not hasattr(tools, '__wrapped_look_up_order__'); print('import ok')" (confirms clean import without strands/boto3)
findings:
Implemented in app/assistant/tools.py and app/assistant/handler.py; tests in app/tests/test_tools.py (rewritten) + app/tests/test_handler.py (new). py_compile clean; pytest app/tests = 31 passed (baseline 16 + 15 new); import-safety verified with strands/boto3/botocore/aws_xray_sdk blocked (handler imports, _build_agent not run at import, build_response works on a plain dict, no bare tools.look_up_order symbol).

CONTRACTS FOR LATER FEATURES:

OrdersTable item shape (exact attribute names, written by place_order; seed in deploy.sh must match): orderId:S (PK, 'ORD-NNNNNN' 6-digit, passes pii.validate_order_id ^ORD-[0-9]{6}$), summary:S (server-normalized 'Nx Title Cased, ...' then pii.mask_pii), total:N (DynamoDB Decimal via Decimal(str(total)); readers coerce float), status:S (persisted baseline always 'RECEIVED'), createdAt:N (int(time.time()), GSI sort key), gsiPk:S (constant 'ORDER', GSI partition key). byCreatedAt GSI = PK gsiPk, SK createdAt, projection ALL.

derive_status thresholds (FEAT-002 orders_list MUST mirror these IDENTICALLY): PREPARING_AFTER=20, READY_AFTER=60. Half-open intervals: elapsed<20 -> RECEIVED, elapsed<60 -> PREPARING, else READY (elapsed==60 -> READY). Boundary tests pinned: 19->RECEIVED, 20->PREPARING, 59->PREPARING, 60->READY.

MENU_PRICES (server-side source of truth): flat white 4.50, latte 4.75, croissant 3.00, coco cake 5.25. price_order() grammar: comma-split; optional leading '<int> x'/'<int>x'; item key = re.sub(r'\\s+',' ', raw.strip()).lower(); exact names only (no plurals); qty default 1, reject qty non-numeric/<=0/>20; reject unknown item, empty, total<=0; normalized_summary rebuilt as 'Nx Title Cased' joined by ', '; total round(,2).

/api/chat placedOrder envelope (FEAT-003 SPA reacts to data.placedOrder + .orderId): build_response adds body['placedOrder'] = {orderId, summary, total, status} from req_ctx['placed_orders'][-1] ONLY (side channel, never model text). req_ctx initialized {'pending_refunds':[], 'placed_orders':[]}. place_order model-facing return: {status:'RECEIVED', orderId, summary, total}. look_up_order LOCKED shapes: {status:'REJECTED',reason:...} (no table call) | {status:'NOT_FOUND',orderId} | {status:'OK',orderId,summary,total(float),orderStatus(derived),createdAt(int)} - status and orderStatus never collapse.

HARD INVARIANTS preserved: side-channel-only id in build_response; pii.mask_pii applied to summary before put_item; total computed server-side from MENU_PRICES; no model-id change; assistant IAM/env untouched (code-only). Conditional put ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(orderId)' with exactly one id-regeneration retry on ConditionalCheckFailedException, then clean REJECT 'could not allocate order id'; ClientError referenced via err.response['Error']['Code'] at runtime (no top-level botocore import).
